name: Sumita Daigo
source:
He may seem flashy like a yakuza, but he's a manager of a hair salon and a hairdresser. With a free-spirited and whimsical personality, he's a true hedonist - he gets an erection as soon as he sees someone he likes, regardless of gender.

[spoiler] He is a former lover of Naruomi. [/spoiler]

[Source [URL=http://zombilica.com/games/nienomati_iromusubi/chara_16daigo.html[/URL] official website profile.]
